id./param/scenario/cs/a_170_cs_120.pack|cs_: "Aaagh!
"Now, Snorri! Use the sealing spell!
"Okay, here goes...
"Pella, mella, fell and feller! Fabula ferocius!
"N-No! Stop it! P-Please, anything but that!
"Aaagh!
"Helter, skelter, bind and belt her! Anima atrocius! Liber claustra cabalistic! Hex-...?
"Hmm... I wonder how this word is pronounced...
"Snorri! What kind of scholar are you!? Pull yourself together!
"Ah yes, I remember now! Liber claustra cabalistic...
"Hexpialidocius!
"Nooo! No, please! Forgive me! I'll do anything! I'll change my ways, I promi-
"Look! The ice is melting!
"Look! The ice, it's melting...!
"Wh... Where am I?
"Your Majesty! Is it really you?
"...Oh yes! I remember now! The witch trapped me in that book and pretended to be me, didn't she?
"Thank goodness. I worried the ordeal might have muddled your memory. Fear not, the witch is sealed away once more.
"Your Majesty! We've been searching for you everywhere! The Chancellor is beside himself with worry!
"Thank you so much for saving my kingdom. I must see that you are justly rewarded.
"You need the Blue Orb, don't you? I heard you from inside the book. Come see me at the castle. I will gladly give it to you.
"As for the grimoire, Snorri, why not give it to me?
"Hold on a minute, Your Majesty! I don't think you understand how dangerous that book is! Let us take care of it.
"Oh, umm... Yes, of course...
"Yes! Another Orb for the collection! Let's go to the castle and get our reward!
"Here, I'll let you keep hold of this.
{var:1} received the witch's grimoire!
